meaning:
ἀνα-μένω
[in LXX for קָוָה pi. ;]
to await "one whose coming is expected, perhaps with the added idea of patience and confidence" with accusative, 1Th.1:10 (see M, Th., in l; MM, VGT, see word).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
